meta.name: higgsfield-generate
meta.description:
Generate images/videos/3D assets/audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults:
GPT Image 2 for image/design/text, Seedance 2.0 for
video, Nano Banana 2/Lite/Pro for character/reference
images, Marketing Studio for ads, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio.
Use when: "generate an image", "make a video", "animate
this photo", "image-to-video", "edit/stylize/remix this
image", "reframe this video", "edit this video from a
sketch", "create a 3D model/GLB", "create a sound effect",
"make music", "text-to-audio", "create an ad", "make a UGC
video", "unboxing", "presenter video", "import product from
URL", or "analyze video virality". Supports image-to-3D
(`multi_image_to_3d`),
text-to-audio/music (`seed_audio`), workflow generation
(`draw_to_video`, `reframe`), Marketing Studio, and
Virality Predictor (`brain_activity`).
Chain with higgsfield-soul-id for face/identity consistency.
NOT for: Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id),
product photoshoots, marketplace listing cards,
text/chat/TTS tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成图片、视频、3D模型和音频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成多种媒体内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate images, videos, 3D models, and audio with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate various media assets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成图片、视频、3D 模型或音频，也能分析视频的传播潜力。
howto.when: 当你提出“生成一张图片”“制作一个视频”“创建3D模型”“生成音效”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张赛博朋克风格的城市夜景图。
say.note: Claude 会用默认图片模型生成。

say.text: 把这张照片转成视频，时长5秒。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Seedance 2.0 模型。

say.text: 分析这个广告视频的吸引力。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate images, videos, 3D models, or audio from your description, and also analyze video virality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate an image, video, 3D model, audio, or analyze a video.

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk city night scene.
say_en.note: Claude uses the default image model.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a 5-second video.
Analyze this ad video for virality.
